rel_value.description: Relative value, market-neutral: top-30 Hyperliquid coins by market cap; once a day go long the 5 strongest and short the 5 weakest over the last 7 days (equal dollars each side, keep a coin while it stays in the top/bottom 8). Skips coins whose move is extreme (more than 2 standard deviations from the pack): crashed coins tend to bounce violently. Trades smaller (down to 1/3 size) when its own daily swings are bigger than usual. New longs only while BTC is above its 100-day average (shorts always). Watched every hour: if the book loses 5% in a day it is cut in half until the next daily rebalance

ta_trend.description: TA trend: 4H Donchian breakout (close beyond the 200-candle / ~33-day high or low) when ADX confirms a trend; 2 ATR trailing stop, exit on the opposite breakout, 1% risk. Picked over 4H EMA crossovers by the backtest

carry.description: Funding carry (no price bet): for coins listed on both Hyperliquid and Aster, short where funding is high and buy where it is low, equal dollars, so price moves cancel and the funding gap is collected. Holds the 5 biggest 7-day gaps (20%+ a year), re-checked every 3 days; both legs are closed together if either moves 25% against itself or the two prices drift 15% apart

turbo.description: Turbo (growth): copies the relative-value and TA trend bots, each on a third of its money at 5x, plus the funding-carry bot on 50% of its money (no extra leverage, never trimmed). Shrinks the directional copies when its own daily swings exceed 1.25%, and keeps shrinking them if it falls 12%+ below its peak. Backtest: $500 -> $2,343, worst drop -14.3%

trend_2x.description: Trend 2x: exactly the TA trend bot's rules (4H breakout of the ~33-day high/low with ADX, 2 ATR trailing stop) at 2% risk per trade instead of 1%. Six-year backtest: +37% a year, every year positive, worst drop -43%

rotation.description: Rotation (calm core): once a day, holds BTC while BTC is above its 100-day average, else gold while gold is above its 100-day average, else cash. No leverage. Six-year backtest: +61% a year, worst drop -44% (holding BTC: +34% a year, -77%)

momentum_3d.description: Trend: go with the last 3 days' direction

momentum_7d.description: Trend: go with the last 7 days' direction

crowd_follow.description: Positioning: go WITH the crowded side (funding far above baseline = longs paying = go long)

crowd_fade.description: Positioning: go AGAINST the crowded side (squeeze bet)

news.description: News: themes in the last 24h headlines, using measured reactions once learned

combo.description: Self-learning: weighted vote of the signals above, weights = their live win rate edge

ms_struct.description: Retired Nov 3: lost 78% over the six-year backtest (every coin negative).

news_regime.description: Retired Nov 3: never traded: needs the paid AI news analyst.

watcher.description: Retired Nov 3: copied the other bots at 1x; its learning added nothing in the backtest.
